results.title: Framer Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
Based on 259 reviews

Review Framer?

Reviewers mostly see Framer as a fast, design-first way to build polished landing pages and marketing sites, especially for people comfortable with Figma-style tools. They repeatedly praise smooth animations, responsive layouts, quick publishing, and strong performance, with several founders saying it helped their teams ship sites without blocking engineering, including the makers of Kodezi. The main caveats are consistent: a steeper-than-expected learning curve for beginners, limited CMS and integrations for complex sites, occasional performance bloat on heavy pages, and pricing, billing, or support frustrations.
